title: Factoring in Findings from Environmental Impact Studies for Development of Former Keppel Club and Gillman Barracks Sites
what_it_is: Factoring in Findings from Environmental Impact Studies for Development of Former Keppel Club and Gillman Barracks Sites

sections.label: Gillman Barracks redevelopment housing studies
sections.summary: The Government is studying redeveloping Gillman Barracks for public and private housing, with environmental and heritage studies starting in the second quarter.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: As announced during the recent Committee of Supply debate, the Government is studying the possibility of redeveloping the Gillman Barracks site for a mix of public and private housing.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: This will not affect the committed tenure of existing tenancies, which will progressively expire by 2030.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We will commence environmental and heritage studies in the second quarter of this year to guide the sensitive development of the site.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: When the studies are complete, we will publish these reports online for members of the public to provide their feedback.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Our plans will also take into account past studies, including findings on ecological connectivity from the National Parks Board (NParks’) Ecological Profiling Exercise (EPE) and the Environmental Impact Study (EIS) for the redevelopment of the former Keppel Golf Course site.

sections.label: Gillman Barracks masterplanning and Keppel EPE
sections.summary: Masterplanning for Gillman Barracks will follow detailed studies and consider the Keppel Golf Course EIS and EPE findings, including five corridors.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: As I said earlier in my reply, the masterplanning for the Gillman Barracks site will take place after we have done detailed environmental and heritage studies and that the planning for Gillman Barracks will take into account the EIS findings for the Keppel Golf Course site, in as far as the EPE findings are concerned.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: In the Keppel Golf Course EPE, we identified five corridors that need to be provided for, even as we redevelop the site for residential housing on the golf course.

sections.label: Environmental and heritage studies online
sections.summary: The environmental and heritage studies will be made available online.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: As for heritage, the studies for both the environmental and heritage studies will be made available online.
